definition: עָגוּר noun [masculine] apparently understood by Masoretes as name of a bird; very uncertain; crane according to Saad (Isaiah), but note of crane not suitable ( Tristr NHB 239 f. ); — וְתוֺר וְסוּס וְעָגוּר Jer 8:7 כְּסוּס עָגוּר Isa 38:14 (but here gloss Klo Brd Di Dn Che Hpt ); Thes and (in Jeremiah) Hi Gf Gie strike out וְ and take ׳ ע as adjective of סוס = twittering or the like; Thes assumes transpos. from גער , Ethiopic cry . I, II, III. עַד see I. עדה . עֵד see עוד . עֹד see עוֺד . עִדֹּא see עדד . below,

עָגוּר noun [masculine] apparently understood by Masoretes as name of a bird; very uncertain; crane according to Saad (Isaiah), but note of crane not suitable (TristrNHB 239 f.); — וְתוֺר וְסוּס וְעָגוּר Jer 8:7 כְּסוּס עָגוּר Isa 38:14 (but here gloss Klo Brd Di Dn CheHpt); Thes and (in Jeremiah) Hi Gf Gie strike out וְ and take ׳ע as adjective of סוס = twittering or the like; Thes assumes transpos. from גער, Ethiopic cry.

I, II, III. עַד see I. עדה. עֵד see עוד.

עֹד see עוֺד. עִדֹּא see עדד. below,
